inplane flow cg iterssim.inplane_flow_cg_itersMembrane transport and water, Implicit step641EXAMPLE

Source statement

numerical budget, not physics: the fixed Jacobi-PCG iteration count of the backward-Euler edge solve in physics.surface_count_flow. Explicit time stepping is unusable here — at the native spacing the fastest face pair relaxes in ~5e-7 s against a step of 1e-2 s — so the solve is implicit and run to a BUDGET, never to a tolerance that would need a host read inside the step. Conservation of the total count does not depend on this number (the unknown is the per-edge flux and every edge hands its two faces the same value with opposite signs); an under-solved step redistributes LESS, never more or from nowhere. 64 is a starting budget for a system whose condition number is about 1 + dt x lambda_max. The per-step record reports aggregate count/conservation diagnostics; the full per-face count is declared dynamic provider state, but continuation still requires recorder integration and a verified restore.

Declared range

[1.0, 512.0] 1

A declared range is not automatically a confidence interval or a completed sweep.

inplane count floor fractionsim.inplane_count_floor_fractionMembrane transport and water, Implicit step0.051EXAMPLE

Source statement

positivity guard, not physics: no face may fall below this fraction of the count it was built with, because a face whose reference area reaches zero has no tension law left. Enforced by scaling each edge's one antisymmetric flux with its donor face's allowance, so the guard cannot create or destroy material the way clipping each face after the update would. One starved face therefore does not freeze the whole sheet. A run that reaches the floor is a run whose redistribution was limited, and the minimum donor allowance is in the record; it is not a failure of the step.

Declared range

[0.001, 0.5] 1

A declared range is not automatically a confidence interval or a completed sweep.

proximal fractioncortex.proximal_fractionFormin population0.81EXAMPLE

Source statement

the fraction of cortex filaments laid in the membrane-proximal HALF of the shell (build/cortex._depth; 0.5 = uniform through the thickness, the pre-2026-09-17 build). The cortex is densest under the membrane (Clark 2013 Biophys J 105:570 — cortical actin within ~100-200 nm of the membrane, thickness profile from super-resolution; Chugh 2017 Nat Cell Biol 19:689 — thickness/density set by the length distribution): a value above 0.5 puts that structure in. RESULT-2026-09-15 s10.15: at 0.5, 9.1 % of membrane vertices are farther than erm.reach (45 nm) from any cortex segment at build. Not sourced as a number; SET 0.8 on 2026-09-17 11:15 from the build measurement (RESULT-2026-09-15 s10.16, NMII minifilaments on the same profile): membrane vertices beyond erm.reach 9.1 % (0.5) -> 2.4 % (0.8), NMII heads beyond crossbridge.reach 14.4 % -> 12.8 %; 0.9 was not taken (the profile then has 90 % of the cortex in 100 nm, beyond what the density literature supports).

Declared range

[0.5, 0.9] 1

dormant fractioncortex.dormant_fractionFormin population0.11EXAMPLE

Source statement

dormant node rows allocated per live cortex node for the growth insert pool, ceil(fraction x live) (DESIGN-2026-09-08-growth-wiring §3.1, §4; actin-chemistry §2.2). Sizing arithmetic, not a claim: zero-load elongation delta(k_on c - k_off) = +11.9 nm/s at the fast end is one node (L0 = 0.05 um) per ~4.2 s per chain, so a 1 s row on 60-node chains uses ~0.004 of the family's nodes — 0.1 is a 25x margin. The census records n_dormant and pool_top; an exhausted pool counts pool_exhausted, it does not silently stop

Source statement

PI-GAP, and a STAND-IN that is to be REPLACED rather than sourced. The in-plane flow law v = grad(sigma)/b needs a drag per unit area per unit in-plane velocity; membrane-cortex friction is reported around 1e8-1e9 Pa.s/m (tether-pulling and flow measurements of the Shi/Baumgart kind; 1 Pa.s/m = 1e-6 pN.s/um^3, so 1e2-1e3 in these units) — quoted from memory, NOT read in a paper here and NOT in the KB source_audit, hence EXAMPLE and hence a range that is exploratory and not a confidence interval. The PI's decision (OPTIONS-2026-09-21 item 3) is that this coefficient should EMERGE from the making and breaking of the explicit ERM relations that tie the bilayer to the cortex, the way composite viscosity must be an observable and not an input (directive 9). Area modulusenvelope.area_modulusTension and area, Nuclear envelope486000.0pN/µmSOURCED

Source statement

KB-2026-09-06-nuclear-envelope-shear-modulus §2: unbound from membrane.area_modulus — the nuclear envelope is TWO bilayers in parallel, so K_A = 2 x the single-bilayer value. Rawicz 2000 Biophys J 79:328 (10.1016/S0006-3495(00)76295-3, SE211, audit OK; KB-3.B1.3 verified/High) K_A = 243 mN/m +/- 10 % across 12 PCs = 2.43e5 pN/um -> 4.86e5 here. This is the GLOBAL area term (assemble.py k_area -> Surfaces.k_area, g = k_area/area0 * dA), additive to the mu_2d edge network's own areal response K_A = 2 mu_2d; the membranes are slack until envelope.excess_area = 0.30 is spent, which is why the lamina (Dahl 25 mN/m) and not the bilayers sets the measured NE stiffness. The lamina's own contribution is envelope.mu_2d + the lamina population, NOT this row.

mu 2denvelope.mu_2dShear and local area, Nuclear envelope250.0pN/µmEXAMPLE

Source statement

KB-2026-09-06-nuclear-envelope-shear-modulus §1: unbound from membrane.mu_2d — the plasma membrane's mu is carried by the spectrin/ERM-cortex, the NE's by the NPC-lamin connections; not the same quantity. NO source isolates the double-bilayer + NPC in-plane shear from the lamina's, because the lamin meshwork is its own population here (build/lamina.py). What the OK-verdict evidence constrains is the SUM envelope+lamina: Stephens 2017 MBoC 28:1984 (10.1091/mbc.E16-09-0653, audit OK) single-nucleus micromanipulation gives a short-extension [stiffness] 0.41-0.70 nN/um with 1.5-2.5x strain stiffening carried by lamin-A/C, i.e. a lamin-attributable 2.5e2-7.5e2 pN/um for a somatic mammalian nucleus (a shell [stiffness] k ~ C*mu, C = O(1) — order of magnitude, not a modulus). The lamina as BUILT already delivers 1.3e2-5.1e2 pN/um (EA = material.if.E * pi * material.if.radius^2 = 471 pN over lamina.filament = 0.4 um -> k_edge 1178 pN/um; mu = sqrt(3)k/4 = 510 affine, 128 after the z=4.5 vs z_c=4 knockdown), so 2.5e2 here puts the sum at 3.8e2-7.6e2 pN/um, inside the measured band. Ceiling 2.5e4 = Dahl 2004 J Cell Sci 117:4779 (10.1242/jcs.01357, audit OK, SE562): 25 mN/m network elastic modulus, micropipette aspiration of ISOLATED XENOPUS OOCYTE envelopes — an amphibian lamin-B-rich oocyte NE, 30-100x above the somatic band, and Swift 2013 (10.1126/science.1240104, audit OK) is why it may not be transferred to a human somatic cell unqualified. Dahl does not split K_A from mu; the engine's triangular network fixes K_A = 2 mu, and the measured K/mu is 1.5 +/- 0.3 (HeLa, Rowat 2005) to 5.1 +/- 1.3 (WT MEF, Rowat 2006) — both PENDING SE registration, see the KB doc §3. Its own K_edge = 4 mu_2d / sqrt(3) = 577 pN/um per envelope edge (PLAN-2026-09-03ab §1), x25 tonight's 23.094: the envelope's in-plane branch moves 1.9e5 -> 4.7e6 /s (object_spectra_20260905T152006Z), still below the IF/MT branches. The gate is NOT this row: aspirate the built nucleus and score k_short / k_long against Stephens 0.41-0.70 nN/um and 1.5-2.5x.

The clause that stood here until today — the one asserting that this row fixed the assembled-minifilament fraction, quoted verbatim as the sentinel _ASSEMBLY_CLAIM in cell/nmii_molecules.py and deliberately NOT repeated in this file, so that restoring it here is what trips the refusal — is the reading the build does NOT take: nmii.areal_density (SOURCED, Nie 2015) already counts ASSEMBLED minifilaments and nmii.assembly_rate/nmii.disassembly_rate already fix the assembled fraction at ka/(ka+kd) = 0.5, so applying this row to the object count as well would reduce one population twice and would declare one fraction to be both 0.3 and 0.5. NEITHER VALUE WAS CHANGED to reconcile them — the readings were made disjoint and cell/nmii_molecules.assembled_population refuses the double count with the numbers. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

dimer risemicrotubule.dimer_riseMicrotubules0.008µmEXAMPLE

Source statement

the lattice rise of one tubulin dimer, 8 nm — the end-stroke unit delta of the microtubule family, which is what makes growth_speed a DERIVED on-rate: k_on = growth_speed / (dimer_rise * tubulin_conc) [1/(uM.s)] and the shrink off-rate k_off_b = shrink_speed / dimer_rise [1/s]. LOAD HAZARD, stated where the number is: the on-law multiplies by exp(f*delta/kT), so with delta = 0.008 um and kT = 4.28e-3 pN.um (310 K) one pN of slot load is exp(1.87) = 6.5x and 10 pN is exp(18.7) = 1.3e8 — end_growth clamps the exponent at 50 (f = 26.8 pN), which is a runaway, not a limit. The microtubule family therefore runs under the DECLARED zero load (growth_load = 'zero', the live operating point for actin too); growth_load = 'stretch' is refused for it in assemble.wire_growth. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

kcrosslink.kα-actinin4600.0pN/µmEXAMPLE

Source statement

PI signature 2026-09-11 17:11 (Lead transcript 14373ea7; KB-2026-09-11-crosslink-bell.md): the effective axial stiffness of the alpha-actinin LINKER between two cortex nodes, an elastic element with the bond's rest at the built distance. FERRER MISREAD CORRECTED: the former 4.6e5 ('455 pN/nm, Ferrer 2008 AFM') is Ferrer 2008 PNAS 105:9221 (10.1073/pnas.0706124105, SE119 OK; optical tweezers, not AFM) Hummer-Szabo fit k_BT*kappa_m = 455 +/- 215 pN/nm — the curvature of the actin-ABP BOND's energy well over x‡ 0.28 nm, not the 35-nm rod's stiffness; no direct measurement of the intact rod's axial stiffness exists (EXAMPLE). Two bounds put the value here: (i) self-consistency with crosslink.k_off0 — the resting thermal load sqrt(k_BT k) must be << f_char = k_BT/x_beta, i.e. k << f_char^2/k_BT = 5.7e4 pN/um (at 4.6e5 every bond carried 44 pN rms at rest, Bell x17, and 58 % tore in 10 us on RESULT-2026-09-11-motor-occupancy); (ii) the step — a 4.4-nm thermal kick at dt 1e-6 must not push the Bell exponent past 1: k <= 3.5e3. Molecule: 8 spectrin repeats per rod, folded-repeat stiffness ~1700 pN/nm each (Paramore 2005 MD), flexible terminal regions (Golji 2009), and the repeats UNFOLD at 25-35 pN (Rief 1999 JMB 286:553) below the 40-80 pN bond rupture. DESIGN ITEM (PI 17:11): the crosslink as a YIELDING element — this stiffness up to f_y ~25-35 pN, then ~30 nm of unfolded extension per repeat, refolding < 1 s on release (a bonds/builder change); until then this elastic element is the stand-in

Declared range

molecular modelcrosslink.molecular_modelα-actinin01EXAMPLE

Source statement

WHICH crosslinker representation the build uses, and the ONE row that chooses it. 0 = the incumbent owner-node idiom (the crosslinker is a relation owned by a filament node; cell/bonds.build_kinds). 1 = the finite two-arm MOLECULE of codex/bio-wiring-20260915 (cell/build/crosslinkers.build_two_arm_crosslinker): a massive freely hinged centre node per molecule, two independent arms of length/2 and stiffness 2k, population = conc x actual cytoplasm volume. The two are different physics, not a refactor: the owner-node idiom cannot represent a 0.16 um rod whose capture radius is smaller than its own length without every bond being born compressed, and the two-arm model has no such defect; the molecule model in turn needs the material-site machinery on the device before its arms bind exact monomer sites rather than segment endpoints. Default 0 until one device run compares them. Companion rows (<prefix>.molecular_weight, .radius, .arm_reach) are read only at 1.

k adp releasecrossbridge.k_adp_releaseCrossbridge cycle2.71/sSOURCED

Source statement

PI signature 2026-09-11 11:26 (Lead transcript 14373ea7; KB-2026-09-11-crossbridge-rates.md). ISOFORM ERROR CORRECTED: the former 0.35/s is NMIIB's unloaded ADP release (Kovacs 2007 Table 1: NM2B single-headed 0.38 +/- 0.09, HMM 0.27 +/- 0.06; Wang 2003). NMIIA — the engine's motor (hand_kmc.NMIIA_MYOSIN; x_adp derived for 2A) — is k0 = 2.7 +/- 0.3/s (single-headed, = Kovacs 2003 JBC 278:38132, 10.1074/jbc.M305453200, SE550 OK) / 2.9 +/- 1.0 (HMM); Stam 2015 carries 1.71/s from Kovacs 2003 -> spread: 1.7-2.9/s (lognormal prior, factor 1.3). Kovacs 2007 PNAS 104:9994 (doi 10.1073/pnas.0701181104, PMID 17548820, SE424 OK): resisting load slows it 5x (2A: 2.9 -> 0.59) / 12x (2B), assisting load speeds it 4x (11/s) — the load factors and x_adp were already 2A's, only the base rate was 2B's. Formerly: resisting load slows it 5x (2A) / 12x (2B) at ~2 pN, assisting load speeds it 4x. READ by bonds._crossbridge as the stroked state's detachment (2026-09-06, KB-2026-09-06 §4.8/§7.1b: unbound from the SWEPT k_off0). KB: SE424 Kovacs2007_PNAS, source_audit OK 2026-09-06 12:0x (key repaired from the encoding-stripped Kovcs2007; audit re-run). Spread: the paper gives ~0.35 /s (one significant figure), read as a factor of 1.4 either way

x adpcrossbridge.x_adpCrossbridge cycle0.0034µmSOURCED

Source statement

derived from Kovacs 2007 for NMII-2A ONLY (the motor is hand_kmc.NMIIA_MYOSIN; 2B's 12x would give x = 5.32 nm, f_char = 0.80 pN, OUTSIDE the KB's 1-2 pN — so the 1-2 pN agreement is a consequence of the isoform choice, not an independent confirmation): resisting 2 pN slows ADP release 5x -> x = kT ln5 / 2 pN = 3.44 nm at 310 K; the assisting 4x gives 2.97 nm, so one Bell length fits both within 15 % (it over-predicts the assisting branch by 25 %). f_char = kT/x = 1.24 pN. The SIGN is the mechanism (bonds._crossbridge: tension SLOWS the stroked state's detachment). NMIIB would be 5.3 nm. KB: SE424 Kovacs2007_PNAS, source_audit OK 2026-09-06 12:0x. cells multiplefluid.cells_multipleStokes solvent11EXAMPLE

Source statement

numerical, not biological: cell/assemble.grid_box rounds the fluid box's cell count per side UP to a multiple of this, SYMMETRICALLY. The staggered device grid already rounds to 16 by itself (physics.fluid_mac.MacGrid) but puts the extra cells on the + side only, so the built box is off-centre (row-1 native: 362 asked, 368 built, + walls 0.30 um farther) and is not the box the tables record; 16 here makes the device's rounding a no-op. It buys NO multigrid depth — a first version of this row claimed the native grid had two levels; it has five (368 = 16 x 23), and that claim is withdrawn (2026-09-21). 1 = the box as it always was

cofilin decorated fractionactin_chem.cofilin_decorated_fractionCofilin severing, Nucleotide chemistry0.051EXAMPLE

Source statement

the fraction of built filament subunits carrying cofilin. THIS ROW STANDS IN FOR BINDING KINETICS THAT ARE NOT WIRED: no cofilin binding row exists in this file (nor on codex/bio-wiring-20260915, whose cofilin path is a 64-row molecular G/F preparation that is not ported), so the decoration cannot be computed from the file and is DECLARED. Sized from stoichiometry and from what cofilin does in a resting cell, not from any gate: one cofilin per actin protomer against actin_chem.cofilin_conc 20 uM and the filament this spec builds puts the hard ceiling at 0.0987 on the shipped build (1.021e7 molecules against 1.035e8 built protomers; cell/severing.decorated_fraction_ceiling recomputes it from the BUILT protomer count and refuses anything above it, with both counts in the message); and most cofilin in a resting cell is Ser3-phosphorylated and cannot bind F-actin at all, so the resting decoration sits well under that ceiling. 0.05 is an order-of-magnitude EXAMPLE inside it and a PI-GAP inference target, not a measurement. WARNING the real law (Kadzik 2026, aleph/laws/cofilin_severing.py) severs at decorated/bare BOUNDARIES and peaks at INTERMEDIATE decoration, while the uniform-rate form this row feeds is monotone in it — no run may claim the occupancy dependence. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

nucleation reserve fractionarp23.nucleation_reserve_fractionArp2/3 branches0.01EXAMPLE

Source statement

SHIPPED AT 0 SINCE 2026-09-21 (device, RunPod A100, 353b9c858): with births on, the woken daughters carried 6.8e3 -> 3.8e5 -> 1.2e6 pN within five steps and the all-on cell went non-finite at k = 3; with this row at 0 the same cell is clean (free:cortex force_max 4-17 pN). Cause: a chain born at runtime is NOT in the axial-constraint workspace, so its nodes take independent thermal draws (~1.3 um per 1e-2 s step) against EA/L ~ 9e5 pN/um rows. The law is implemented (physics/chain_birth) and stays inert until the workspace can admit a born chain; 0.1 was the lane's value (1.66 s of births at the ceiling rate). dormant DAUGHTER chain records per built cortex chain, because a branch is a new CHAIN and the chain count is fixed at construction (the same device as actin_chem.severing_reserve_fraction, and they are summed in the layout — one reserve stack, one count per consumer). DERIVED from the rows beside it, not tuned: arp23.conc 2 uM over the cortical shell's water = 1.154e5 free complexes x arp23.nucleation_rate 0.037 /s = 4.27e3 nucleations/s against 7.07e4 built chains, so 0.1 (7.07e3 records) is 1.66 s of nucleation at the ceiling and 3.3 s at the stationary flux (cortex.turnover_rate x the chain count). THAT IS LESS THAN THE 2.5 s COMPRESSION PROTOCOL at the ceiling: a run that outlives its reserve SATURATES and the step is counted (physics/chain_birth no_record), never raised, and the record's saturation step is what a claim must be read against. Sized at 0.1 because each record costs two dead segment rows and NO node, but a woken one takes three nodes from cortex.dormant_fraction's pool, which is 4.3e5 nodes — 7.07e3 x 3 = 2.1e4 of them, 5 % of that pool. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

Declared range

[0.0, 1.0] 1

A declared range is not automatically a confidence interval or a completed sweep.

Source statement

microvillar bundler binding rate — PI-GAP (a target Aleph must find; the number is an initial point). Lengthmicrovillus_bundler.lengthMicrovilli, Bundling proteins0.0085µmEXAMPLE

Source statement

microvillar bundler centre-to-centre SPAN — PI-GAP (a target Aleph must find; the number is an initial point). The microvillar bundler is espin / fimbrin (I-plastin) / villin, NOT fascin: microvillus.spacing is 12 nm and that row's own source names those three, while fascin's sourced bundle spacing is 8 nm (filopodium.spacing, Courson & Rock 2010). NO rate constant for espin, fimbrin, I-plastin or villin exists anywhere in this corpus — searched 2026-09-21 over aleph/references, aleph/docs, aleph/laws and this file; every hit says UNSOURCED (KB-DRAFT-3-23, SE_REGISTRATION_CANDIDATES_2026-06-30, architecture_spec.py 'espin/fimbrin STAND-IN'). So the value here EQUALS the fascin row's value (PI 2026-09-21 20:51): it is where the search starts, not a measurement. Equal to fascin.length (8.1-8.5 nm, Courson & Rock 2010). cell/bonds._bundle_crosslink checks this span against the reach the 12 nm packing implies (shells 12.0 / 20.8 nm, reach 16.39 nm) and REFUSES a span past it. WARNING, reported not refused: 8.5 nm is 3.5 nm SHORTER than the 12 nm first shell this molecule is asked to bridge — the bond rests at the distance it formed at, so nothing is stretched and no force is injected, but a real espin / fimbrin / villin span would be about 12 nm and this row is where that number belongs when a source gives it. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

sites per nodemicrovillus_bundler.sites_per_nodeMicrovilli, Bundling proteins3.01EXAMPLE

Source statement

crosslinker slots one microvillar core node carries, each holding a DIFFERENT neighbour filament (cell/bonds._bundle_crosslink, physics.kinetics sites_per_owner) — PI-GAP (a target Aleph must find; the number is an initial point). A hex-packed filament has up to 6 first-shell neighbours (cell/bonds.bundle_valence_limit measures it on the built packing and REFUSES more), and at 1 every node of a filament picked the same nearest neighbour and a 20-filament bundle came out as 3.235 components (INVENTORY-2026-09-21 E' B1). Chosen as the smallest valence at which the native tubes build measures ONE component per bundle; see that item for the 1 / 2 / 3 table. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

Volume modulusguv.volume_modulusNo model-page mapping in this snapshot773100.0pN/µm²EXAMPLE

Source statement

DERIVED, exactly as membrane.volume_modulus (PI 2026-09-16 18:57): the enclosed ~300 mM solution's linearised van 't Hoff law, K_V = 300 mM x 2577 pN/um^2/mM. REQUIRED here, not optional: at constant tension AND constant pressure the radial mode of a closed surface is UNSTABLE (E = sigma*4 pi R^2 - p*(4/3) pi R^3 has d2E/dR2 = -8 pi sigma at the Laplace point), so a k_volume = 0 vesicle inflates or collapses. Stability needs K_V > 2 sigma / (3 R) = 3.3 pN/um^2 at sigma 50, R 10; the osmotic value is 5 decades above that, i.e. the vesicle is volume-conserving on these time scales, which is also the physics (water permeation is far slower than a step). At build V = V0 so p = p0 = 2 sigma / R exactly and the row costs no offset

sim.inplane_flow_cg_iters64 1example
numerical budget, not physics: the fixed Jacobi-PCG iteration count of the backward-Euler edge solve in physics.surface_count_flow. Explicit time… more stepping is unusable here — at the native spacing the fastest face pair relaxes in ~5e-7 s against a step of 1e-2 s — so the solve is implicit and run to a BUDGET, never to a tolerance that would need a host read inside the step. Conservation of the total count does not depend on this number (the unknown is the per-edge flux and every edge hands its two faces the same value with opposite signs); an under-solved step redistributes LESS, never more or from nowhere. 64 is a starting budget for a system whose condition number is about 1 + dt x lambda_max. The per-step record reports aggregate count/conservation diagnostics; the full per-face count is declared dynamic provider state, but continuation still requires recorder integration and a verified restore.
sim.inplane_count_floor_fraction0.05 1example
positivity guard, not physics: no face may fall below this fraction of the count it was built with, because a face whose reference area reaches zero… more has no tension law left. Enforced by scaling each edge's one antisymmetric flux with its donor face's allowance, so the guard cannot create or destroy material the way clipping each face after the update would. One starved face therefore does not freeze the whole sheet. A run that reaches the floor is a run whose redistribution was limited, and the minimum donor allowance is in the record; it is not a failure of the step.

This row exists so the flow law can run before that emergence is built, and is to be deleted when it is.

envelope.area_modulus486000.0 pN/umsourced
KB-2026-09-06-nuclear-envelope-shear-modulus §2: unbound from membrane.area_modulus — the nuclear envelope is TWO bilayers in parallel, so K_A = 2 x… more the single-bilayer value. Rawicz 2000 Biophys J 79:328 (10.1016/S0006-3495(00)76295-3, SE211, audit OK; KB-3.B1.3 verified/High) K_A = 243 mN/m +/- 10 % across 12 PCs = 2.43e5 pN/um -> 4.86e5 here. This is the GLOBAL area term (assemble.py k_area -> Surfaces.k_area, g = k_area/area0 * dA), additive to the mu_2d edge network's own areal response K_A = 2 mu_2d; the membranes are slack until envelope.excess_area = 0.30 is spent, which is why the lamina (Dahl 25 mN/m) and not the bilayers sets the measured NE stiffness. The lamina's own contribution is envelope.mu_2d + the lamina population, NOT this row.
envelope.mu_2d250.0 pN/umexample
KB-2026-09-06-nuclear-envelope-shear-modulus §1: unbound from membrane.mu_2d — the plasma membrane's mu is carried by the spectrin/ERM-cortex, the… more NE's by the NPC-lamin connections; not the same quantity. NO source isolates the double-bilayer + NPC in-plane shear from the lamina's, because the lamin meshwork is its own population here (build/lamina.py). What the OK-verdict evidence constrains is the SUM envelope+lamina: Stephens 2017 MBoC 28:1984 (10.1091/mbc.E16-09-0653, audit OK) single-nucleus micromanipulation gives a short-extension [stiffness] 0.41-0.70 nN/um with 1.5-2.5x strain stiffening carried by lamin-A/C, i.e. a lamin-attributable 2.5e2-7.5e2 pN/um for a somatic mammalian nucleus (a shell [stiffness] k ~ C*mu, C = O(1) — order of magnitude, not a modulus). The lamina as BUILT already delivers 1.3e2-5.1e2 pN/um (EA = material.if.E * pi * material.if.radius^2 = 471 pN over lamina.filament = 0.4 um -> k_edge 1178 pN/um; mu = sqrt(3)k/4 = 510 affine, 128 after the z=4.5 vs z_c=4 knockdown), so 2.5e2 here puts the sum at 3.8e2-7.6e2 pN/um, inside the measured band. Ceiling 2.5e4 = Dahl 2004 J Cell Sci 117:4779 (10.1242/jcs.01357, audit OK, SE562): 25 mN/m network elastic modulus, micropipette aspiration of ISOLATED XENOPUS OOCYTE envelopes — an amphibian lamin-B-rich oocyte NE, 30-100x above the somatic band, and Swift 2013 (10.1126/science.1240104, audit OK) is why it may not be transferred to a human somatic cell unqualified. Dahl does not split K_A from mu; the engine's triangular network fixes K_A = 2 mu, and the measured K/mu is 1.5 +/- 0.3 (HeLa, Rowat 2005) to 5.1 +/- 1.3 (WT MEF, Rowat 2006) — both PENDING SE registration, see the KB doc §3. Its own K_edge = 4 mu_2d / sqrt(3) = 577 pN/um per envelope edge (PLAN-2026-09-03ab §1), x25 tonight's 23.094: the envelope's in-plane branch moves 1.9e5 -> 4.7e6 /s (object_spectra_20260905T152006Z), still below the IF/MT branches. The gate is NOT this row: aspirate the built nucleus and score k_short / k_long against Stephens 0.41-0.70 nN/um and 1.5-2.5x.

microtubule.dimer_rise0.008 umexample
the lattice rise of one tubulin dimer, 8 nm — the end-stroke unit delta of the microtubule family, which is what makes growth_speed a DERIVED… more on-rate: k_on = growth_speed / (dimer_rise * tubulin_conc) [1/(uM.s)] and the shrink off-rate k_off_b = shrink_speed / dimer_rise [1/s]. LOAD HAZARD, stated where the number is: the on-law multiplies by exp(f*delta/kT), so with delta = 0.008 um and kT = 4.28e-3 pN.um (310 K) one pN of slot load is exp(1.87) = 6.5x and 10 pN is exp(18.7) = 1.3e8 — end_growth clamps the exponent at 50 (f = 26.8 pN), which is a runaway, not a limit. The microtubule family therefore runs under the DECLARED zero load (growth_load = 'zero', the live operating point for actin too); growth_load = 'stretch' is refused for it in assemble.wire_growth. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

crosslink.k4600.0 pN/umexample
PI signature 2026-09-11 17:11 (Lead transcript 14373ea7; KB-2026-09-11-crosslink-bell.md): the effective axial stiffness of the alpha-actinin LINKER… more between two cortex nodes, an elastic element with the bond's rest at the built distance. FERRER MISREAD CORRECTED: the former 4.6e5 ('455 pN/nm, Ferrer 2008 AFM') is Ferrer 2008 PNAS 105:9221 (10.1073/pnas.0706124105, SE119 OK; optical tweezers, not AFM) Hummer-Szabo fit k_BT*kappa_m = 455 +/- 215 pN/nm — the curvature of the actin-ABP BOND's energy well over x‡ 0.28 nm, not the 35-nm rod's stiffness; no direct measurement of the intact rod's axial stiffness exists (EXAMPLE). Two bounds put the value here: (i) self-consistency with crosslink.k_off0 — the resting thermal load sqrt(k_BT k) must be << f_char = k_BT/x_beta, i.e. k << f_char^2/k_BT = 5.7e4 pN/um (at 4.6e5 every bond carried 44 pN rms at rest, Bell x17, and 58 % tore in 10 us on RESULT-2026-09-11-motor-occupancy); (ii) the step — a 4.4-nm thermal kick at dt 1e-6 must not push the Bell exponent past 1: k <= 3.5e3. Molecule: 8 spectrin repeats per rod, folded-repeat stiffness ~1700 pN/nm each (Paramore 2005 MD), flexible terminal regions (Golji 2009), and the repeats UNFOLD at 25-35 pN (Rief 1999 JMB 286:553) below the 40-80 pN bond rupture. DESIGN ITEM (PI 17:11): the crosslink as a YIELDING element — this stiffness up to f_y ~25-35 pN, then ~30 nm of unfolded extension per repeat, refolding < 1 s on release (a bonds/builder change); until then this elastic element is the stand-in

crosslink.molecular_model0 1example
WHICH crosslinker representation the build uses, and the ONE row that chooses it. 0 = the incumbent owner-node idiom (the crosslinker is a relation… more owned by a filament node; cell/bonds.build_kinds). 1 = the finite two-arm MOLECULE of codex/bio-wiring-20260915 (cell/build/crosslinkers.build_two_arm_crosslinker): a massive freely hinged centre node per molecule, two independent arms of length/2 and stiffness 2k, population = conc x actual cytoplasm volume. The two are different physics, not a refactor: the owner-node idiom cannot represent a 0.16 um rod whose capture radius is smaller than its own length without every bond being born compressed, and the two-arm model has no such defect; the molecule model in turn needs the material-site machinery on the device before its arms bind exact monomer sites rather than segment endpoints. Default 0 until one device run compares them. Companion rows (<prefix>.molecular_weight, .radius, .arm_reach) are read only at 1.

SHIPPED AT 0 SINCE 2026-09-21 (device, RunPod A100, 353b9c858): with births on, the woken daughters carried 6.8e3 -> 3.8e5 -> 1.2e6 pN within five… more steps and the all-on cell went non-finite at k = 3; with this row at 0 the same cell is clean (free:cortex force_max 4-17 pN). Cause: a chain born at runtime is NOT in the axial-constraint workspace, so its nodes take independent thermal draws (~1.3 um per 1e-2 s step) against EA/L ~ 9e5 pN/um rows. The law is implemented (physics/chain_birth) and stays inert until the workspace can admit a born chain; 0.1 was the lane's value (1.66 s of births at the ceiling rate). dormant DAUGHTER chain records per built cortex chain, because a branch is a new CHAIN and the chain count is fixed at construction (the same device as actin_chem.severing_reserve_fraction, and they are summed in the layout — one reserve stack, one count per consumer). DERIVED from the rows beside it, not tuned: arp23.conc 2 uM over the cortical shell's water = 1.154e5 free complexes x arp23.nucleation_rate 0.037 /s = 4.27e3 nucleations/s against 7.07e4 built chains, so 0.1 (7.07e3 records) is 1.66 s of nucleation at the ceiling and 3.3 s at the stationary flux (cortex.turnover_rate x the chain count). THAT IS LESS THAN THE 2.5 s COMPRESSION PROTOCOL at the ceiling: a run that outlives its reserve SATURATES and the step is counted (physics/chain_birth no_record), never raised, and the record's saturation step is what a claim must be read against. Sized at 0.1 because each record costs two dead segment rows and NO node, but a woken one takes three nodes from cortex.dormant_fraction's pool, which is 4.3e5 nodes — 7.07e3 x 3 = 2.1e4 of them, 5 % of that pool. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

microvillus_bundler.k_on1.0 1/sexample
microvillar bundler binding rate — PI-GAP (a target Aleph must find; the number is an initial point). The microvillar bundler is espin / fimbrin… more (I-plastin) / villin, NOT fascin: microvillus.spacing is 12 nm and that row's own source names those three, while fascin's sourced bundle spacing is 8 nm (filopodium.spacing, Courson & Rock 2010). NO rate constant for espin, fimbrin, I-plastin or villin exists anywhere in this corpus — searched 2026-09-21 over aleph/references, aleph/docs, aleph/laws and this file; every hit says UNSOURCED (KB-DRAFT-3-23, SE_REGISTRATION_CANDIDATES_2026-06-30, architecture_spec.py 'espin/fimbrin STAND-IN'). So the value here EQUALS the fascin row's value (PI 2026-09-21 20:51): it is where the search starts, not a measurement. Equal to fascin.k_on (Aratyn 2007 turnover ~s). not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED
microvillus_bundler.k_off00.1 1/sexample
microvillar bundler unbinding rate at zero load — PI-GAP (a target Aleph must find; the number is an initial point). The microvillar bundler is espin… more / fimbrin (I-plastin) / villin, NOT fascin: microvillus.spacing is 12 nm and that row's own source names those three, while fascin's sourced bundle spacing is 8 nm (filopodium.spacing, Courson & Rock 2010). NO rate constant for espin, fimbrin, I-plastin or villin exists anywhere in this corpus — searched 2026-09-21 over aleph/references, aleph/docs, aleph/laws and this file; every hit says UNSOURCED (KB-DRAFT-3-23, SE_REGISTRATION_CANDIDATES_2026-06-30, architecture_spec.py 'espin/fimbrin STAND-IN'). So the value here EQUALS the fascin row's value (PI 2026-09-21 20:51): it is where the search starts, not a measurement. Equal to fascin.k_off0 (Aratyn 2007, ORDER OF MAGNITUDE). not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

guv.area_modulus0.0 pN/umexample
DELIBERATELY ZERO. The GUV exists so that sigma is an INPUT (standard.guv.tension) and therefore engine-external truth; with K_A > 0 the surface… more tension becomes a function of the deformation (Surfaces.k_area: sigma = tension0 + K_A max(A/A0 - 1, 0)) and the object no longer has a known tension. The real bilayer K_A = 2.43e5 pN/um (Rawicz 2000 Biophys J 79:328) belongs to the run that models the excess-area reservoir the holding pipette pays out of; PI switches it on there, not here
guv.volume_modulus773100.0 pN/um^2example
DERIVED, exactly as membrane.volume_modulus (PI 2026-09-16 18:57): the enclosed ~300 mM solution's linearised van 't Hoff law, K_V = 300 mM x 2577… more pN/um^2/mM. REQUIRED here, not optional: at constant tension AND constant pressure the radial mode of a closed surface is UNSTABLE (E = sigma*4 pi R^2 - p*(4/3) pi R^3 has d2E/dR2 = -8 pi sigma at the Laplace point), so a k_volume = 0 vesicle inflates or collapses. Stability needs K_V > 2 sigma / (3 R) = 3.3 pN/um^2 at sigma 50, R 10; the osmotic value is 5 decades above that, i.e. the vesicle is volume-conserving on these time scales, which is also the physics (water permeation is far slower than a step). At build V = V0 so p = p0 = 2 sigma / R exactly and the row costs no offset
